items.title: Isaiah Morgan Interview, 1958-12-01
items.q: I could never get in touch with George and Lewis. I could never get that boy's phone number.

ctx.x: And I don't see why they turned that way. And I don't see why they turned anymore. I think he couldn't travel or something. Maybe I think he had a job here and they went on the road. Alvin didn't want to go on the road or something.

Because Jim, Jim is, and Howard is friends. And then they had them fired Howard. And I don't know why they had taken him back. And I could never get in touch with George and Lewis. I could never get that boy's phone number. I asked Jim his phone number. He told me, look in the phone book.

items.title: Isaiah Morgan Interview, 1958-12-01
items.q: I tried to get him to play with me over the lake once or twice.

ctx.x: I tried to get him to play with me over the lake once or twice. When his wife, he married one of my cousins, the first wife, would die. Janette. Yeah. And I couldn't get him to come over the lake. Just for one night and get him. I tried to get this old boy Cleo. You know Cleo, the bass player? I heard about him, but he died before I got here. Boy, that was the coming bass player. He could play. He was playing with me. Then, uh... After he... Fooled on you and let's sit in the desk. I don't have no time for that…
